lobby.shareText: Join my Entrika table. Room code: {code}
lobby.sultanPick: {term.suleyman:the} is picked at random; to choose, tap the {term.suleyman} icon on a row.
lobby.learningWhy: No {term.companion:pl}, {term.ambition:pl} or {term.favor} powers; for a first game.
lobby.seatWhy: Order the list the way you sit around the table: {term.objection:pl} go round in this order.
rules.goal.ruler: *{term.suleyman:the}* is one player, known to all and always loyal. Each {term.crisis}, {term.suleyman:the} appoints the two {term.minister:pl} who decide it.
rules.goal.sides: Everyone else is dealt a secret {term.allegiance} card: *{term.loyalist}* or *{term.traitor}*. The {term.traitor:pl} know each other; nobody else knows anyone.
rules.goal.win: The {term.loyalist:pl} win at {loyalty} {term.hizmet} cards, the {term.traitor:pl} at {treason} {term.hiyanet} cards: the last one is {treason.death}. More in [[fate]].
rules.goal.race: Nobody is knocked out. On the winning side, the player with the most {term.influence} wins outright, so allies compete too. More in [[influence]].
rules.goal.talk: Talking is the game: accuse, promise, lie. Always out loud, to the whole table. Nobody may show a hidden card.
rules.hold.character: *{term.character}*, public: who you are. Its two powers are your {term.base}, ready from the start, and your {term.favor}, locked until your {term.ambition} is done. Each works once a game unless the card says otherwise. A power with a set moment is offered to you when it can matter.
rules.hold.allegiance: *{term.allegiance}*, secret: {term.loyalist} or {term.traitor}. Press and hold it to look.
rules.hold.companion: *{term.companion}*, public: your helper. Once per {term.crisis} it lets you play any {term.intrigue} card as its own card. It works only while you have at least 1 {term.influence}.
rules.hold.hand: *{term.intrigue} cards*, secret: up to {hand} in hand. Even how many you hold is secret. More in [[court]].
rules.hold.ambition: *{term.ambition}*, secret: a personal goal. Complete it and it is revealed at the end of that {term.crisis}, unlocking your {term.favor}.
rules.hold.influence: *{term.influence}*, public: your score. You start with 1. More in [[influence]].
rules.hold.ruler: *{term.suleyman:the}* holds none of these. Instead: the appointments, the {term.decree}, {power.ferman} once a game, and the powers each {term.hiyanet} brings.
rules.hold.learning: A learning game leaves out the {term.companion:pl}, the {term.ambition:pl} and the {term.favor} powers.
rules.crisis.crisis: A card flips. It opens a field ({term.divan}, {term.harem}, or both: {term.saray}) and says who draws {term.intrigue:a} card.
rules.crisis.appoint: {term.suleyman:the} names the {term.min1} and the {term.min2}. Then, in seat order, anyone may pay 1 {term.influence} to bring one of them down: {term.objection:a}. {term.suleyman:the} picks who comes in, and the one removed draws a card. Once per {term.crisis} each, never against your own seat.
rules.crisis.court: Everyone but {term.suleyman:the} plays {term.intrigue} cards on each other in waves, in secret and all at once. A wave where nobody plays is the last. More in [[court]].
rules.crisis.kader: The {term.min1} draws 3 {term.kader} cards, discards 1 and passes 2. The {term.min2} discards 1 and plays the other. Nobody talks. More in [[fate]].
rules.crisis.result: The card goes on its track; some {term.hiyanet} spaces hand {term.suleyman:the} a power. Then the {term.minister:pl} explain themselves. They may claim anything, but nobody shows a hidden card.
rules.crisis.decree: After {term.hizmet}, {term.suleyman:the} gives 1 {term.influence} to one {term.minister}; after {term.hiyanet}, takes 1 from one. Who gets which shows whom {term.suleyman:the} trusts.
rules.court.waves: *Waves.* Each wave, everyone but {term.suleyman:the} secretly plays one {term.intrigue} card on a player, or passes. The cards flip together and all take effect at once. There is no limit per {term.crisis}; a wave where nobody plays is the last.
rules.court.fields: *Fields.* Every card is {term.divan} or {term.harem}. {term.divan} cards move the {term.minister} seats; {term.harem} cards work on {term.influence} and secrets. Only the field the {term.crisis} opened can be played, and {term.saray} opens both.
rules.court.anon: *Nobody signs.* Every phone sees each card, its target and what it did, but never who played it. A few cards and powers tell you, in secret, who played what.
rules.court.companion: *Your {term.companion}.* Once per {term.crisis}, play any card as your {term.companion}'s own, even from a closed field. The table sees only the card it became.
rules.court.timing: *All at once.* Protections work from their own wave and last the whole {term.crisis}. A card that needs a {term.minister} checks for one when its wave flips.
rules.court.draw: *Drawing.* You draw 1 {term.intrigue} card when the {term.crisis} card says so, for each {term.influence} you lose, and when you lose a {term.minister} seat. Your hand limit is {hand}.
rules.court.end: *When the waves end,* secret looks go to their owners, then {term.suleyman:the} may use {power.ferman} to replace one {term.minister}.
rules.fate.min1: *The {term.min1}* draws 3 {term.kader} cards in secret, discards 1 face down and passes 2.
rules.fate.min2: *The {term.min2}* discards 1 of the 2 and plays the other face up.
rules.fate.silence: Nobody talks or shows a card meanwhile. Either {term.minister} may discard or play anything, so a bad card can always be blamed on the other.
rules.fate.deck: The deck holds {h} {term.hizmet} cards and {x} {term.hiyanet} cards: mostly bad news. Discards are shuffled back in when it runs low.
rules.fate.loyalty: *{term.loyalty}:* each {term.hizmet} fills a space. At {loyalty}, the {term.loyalist:pl} win.
rules.fate.treason: *{term.treason}:* each {term.hiyanet} fills a space, and some spaces give {term.suleyman:the} a power at once:
rules.influence.start: Everyone but {term.suleyman:the} starts with 1 {term.influence}. It is public, never drops below 0 and has no cap.
rules.influence.decree: It comes and goes mostly with the {term.decree}; some cards and powers move it too. Each {term.influence} you lose draws you {term.intrigue:a} card.
rules.influence.objection: {term.objection:a} costs {cost} {term.influence}. That is spending, not losing, so it draws no card.
rules.influence.zero: At 0, your {term.companion} turns face down and does nothing until you gain again.
rules.influence.winner: *Who wins.* When a side wins, everyone shows their {term.allegiance}. On the winning side, the most {term.influence} wins. A tie goes to whoever completed their {term.ambition}; still tied, they share it. {term.suleyman:the} wins with the {term.loyalist:pl} but isn't in this race.
wait.sultanCourt: {term.court} is on. When a wave passes with no cards, it's your turn for {power.ferman}.
wait.kader: {term.kader} step: nobody talks, nobody shows a card.
ask.tie: The players with the least {term.influence} are tied. Who draws?
ask.appoint: Appoint two {term.minister:pl}. You can't appoint yourself.
ask.appointSadrazam: {power.sadrazam}: you appoint both {term.minister:pl}; you may appoint yourself.
ask.kulis: {power.kulis}: {name} is talking to you in private for a minute.
ask.replace.objection: {removed} lost the seat to {term.objection:a}. Who do you appoint as {seat}?
ask.replace.valide: {card.valide}: {removed} goes. Who comes in as {seat}? You may pick yourself.
ask.next.court: {term.objection:pl} are over. When everyone has spoken, open {term.court}.
ask.waveHow: Tap a card to read and play it.
ask.waveTarget: Pick a target: tap a glowing seat.
ask.redirect: You may move a card played on you to another player.
ask.ferman: {term.court} is over. With {power.ferman} you may replace {term.minister:a}; {card.muhur} can't stop you.
ask.investigate: You are {term.investigator:the}. Whose {term.allegiance} will you look at in secret?
ask.hazineName: {treason.hazineDefteri}: who looks at the top 3 cards of the {term.kader} deck?
ask.discardHow: Tap a card, read it, discard it.
ask.keepOne: {power.yakipYikma}: pick the 1 card you keep; the rest go.
ask.companionWhy: {name}, take one of the two {term.companion:pl}; the other goes back in the box. Your {term.companion} works only while you have at least 1 {term.influence}.
ask.kaderSecond: {first} sent you two cards. Play one.
ask.decreeTakeWhy: {term.hiyanet} was played. Whoever loses draws {term.intrigue:a} card.
ask.venedik: The top 3 cards of the {term.kader} deck.
ask.venedikHow: You may put one on the bottom; the others stay in order.
window.cephe: You may choose this {term.crisis}'s field: {term.divan}, {term.harem} or {term.saray}.
window.kulis: Before {term.suleyman:the} appoints, you may talk with them in private for a minute.
window.sadrazam: This {term.crisis}, you appoint both {term.minister:pl} instead of {term.suleyman:the}.
window.feragat: You may hand your seat to an eligible player and gain 1 {term.influence}.
window.gozcu: You may look in secret at the card the {term.min1} discarded.
window.veliaht: {term.court} is over. You may take {term.minister:a}'s seat, even under {card.muhur}; the one you replace draws {term.intrigue:a} card.
window.fisilti: At the {term.decree}, you may choose which {term.minister} {dir} the {term.influence}.
window.himaye: Before {term.court}, pick a player: this {term.crisis}, {term.intrigue} cards can't unseat them and they lose no {term.influence}, {term.decree} included.
endTreason: The fifth {term.hiyanet} is played. {term.suleyman:the} is dead.
overallWhy: Most {term.influence} on the winning side; on a tie, whoever completed their {term.ambition} wins.
sultanSecretWhy: Everyone knows you are loyal. You have no {term.allegiance} or {term.ambition}; the powers of the {term.treason} are yours.
noSecrets: You haven't seen any secrets yet.

peek.kaderTop.venedikPostasi: {power.venedikPostasi}: the top 3 cards of the {term.kader} deck.
